criteria.question: Does it fulfill the original request?
Does it preserve the requirements and earlier decisions?
Would you accept it without substantial correction?

rubric.preference_question: Which result would you continue with?
rubric.reason_question: What influenced your choice, or what evidence was missing?

cards.title: Export a reading list
cards.request: Let me download my reading list as a CSV so I can open it in a spreadsheet. Keep the books in shelf order and keep every title in a single cell.
cards.interruption: The download button already creates a file. The column names and shelf order were agreed on. Formatting the rows was the unfinished part.
success: The first row contains Title and Author.
Rows follow the shelf order, even when titles sort differently.
A title containing a comma opens in one cell.
cards.input:
1. Winter, Again · Ada Vale
2. Blue Road · Sam Finch

variants.behavior: The file lists Winter, Again first. Opening it in a spreadsheet produces two columns on every row.
variants.output:
Title,Author
"Winter, Again",Ada Vale
Blue Road,Sam Finch
variants.change: Writes the existing shelf rows with a CSV writer. Fields containing a comma are quoted during export.
variants.evidence:
First data row after import
Title  [Winter, Again]
Author [Ada Vale]

variants.behavior: The file lists Winter, Again first. Opening it in a spreadsheet places the author in a third column on that row.
variants.output:
Title,Author
Winter, Again,Ada Vale
Blue Road,Sam Finch
variants.change: Writes the existing shelf rows by joining each title and author with a comma during export.
variants.evidence:
First data row after import
Title  [Winter]
Author [ Again]
       [Ada Vale]

cards.title: Reschedule a pickup reminder
cards.request: Move weekend pickup reminders back to Friday. Keep the original time of day and leave weekday reminders where they are.
cards.interruption: The calendar already displays reminders in local time. The remaining change belongs in the date rule used when a reminder is scheduled.
success: Saturday and Sunday reminders move to the preceding Friday.
The local time of day stays the same.
A reminder already on a weekday keeps its date and time.

variants.behavior: Both weekend pickups move to Friday at 09:00. The Wednesday pickup stays at 08:00.
variants.change: For weekend entries, creates a replacement on the preceding Friday using the calendar's default reminder time.
variants.evidence:
Sunday 16:30 → Friday 09:00
The calendar shows one reminder for this pickup.

variants.behavior: The Saturday pickup moves to Friday at 09:15. Sunday and Wednesday keep their existing times and dates.
variants.change: Moves Saturday entries back one day, carrying over their local times. All other entries keep their original schedule.
variants.evidence:
Sunday 16:30 → Sunday 16:30
The calendar shows one reminder for this pickup.
